newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks post record close of 4,121.56 points.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks post record close of 4,121.56 points.

text.p: Mexican stocks posted a record close of 4,121.56 points on Wednesday after rising 61.5 points or 1.52 percent on very heavy trading volume volume.
Traders and analysts said share prices continued a rally that began on Tuesday when the government announced a three-year economic plan that projects higher rates of GDP growth through the year 2000.
The previous record close of 4,060.60 points for the IPC index of blue chip stocks was set on Tuesday, and Wednesday's closing level marked the 23rd record of the year.
